    function AddTransferToggle() {			
		var options = {
			'formType': 'GET',
			'title' : 'Add Transfer',
			'url' : "/HBNet/App/Transfer/AddTransfer",
			'height':'auto',
			'width':'800',
			'closeMethod':null,
			'isIframe':false              
		};

		openMainDialogWindow(options);  
    }	

	function AddTransferWithAccountAmount(accountId, amount) {

		var baseUrl = "/HBNet/App/Transfer/AddTransferWithAccountAmount?accountId=ACCOUNTID_PLACEHOLDER&amount=AMOUNT_PLACEHOLDER";
		var fullUrl = baseUrl.replace("ACCOUNTID_PLACEHOLDER", accountId);
		fullUrl = fullUrl.replace("AMOUNT_PLACEHOLDER", amount);

		var options = {
			'formType': 'GET',
			'title': 'Add Transfer',
			'url': fullUrl,
			'height': 'auto',
			'width': '800',
			'closeMethod': null,
			'isIframe': false
		};

		openMainDialogWindow(options);
	}

	function lmfaChallengeOpenModal() {
		var options = {
			'formType': 'POST',
			'title' : '',
			'url' : "/HBNet/App/SecondAuthentication/Challenge",
			'height':'auto',
			'width':'800',
			'closeMethod':null,
			'isIframe':false              
		};

		openMainDialogWindow(options);  
	}

	function lmfaOpenModal() {
		var options = {
			'formType': 'GET',
			'title' : '',
			'url' : "/HBNet/App/SecondAuthentication/Method",
			'height':'auto',
			'width':'800',
			'closeMethod':null,
			'isIframe':false              
		};

		openMainDialogWindow(options);  
	}
	
	function ComposeEmailToggle() {
        var url = '/HBNet/App/Email/NewEmail?id=PLACEHOLDER';
        url = url.replace('PLACEHOLDER', 0);

		var options = {
            "title" : "Compose New Email",
            "url" : url,
            "formType" : "POST",
            "height":"auto",
            "width":"700",
            "closeMethod":null              
        };
            
        openMainDialogWindow(options);
	}

	function displayHelpTopic(helpTopic) {			
		
		var url = "/HBNet/App/Content/HelpTopics/HELP_TOPIC_PLACEHOLDER/index.html";
		url = url.replace('HELP_TOPIC_PLACEHOLDER', helpTopic);
		
		switch($.trim(helpTopic.toLowerCase())) {
			case "alerts":
				url = "/HBNet/App/Content/HelpTopics/Alerts/index.html";
				break;
			case "billpay":
				url = "/HBNet/App/Content/HelpTopics/BillPay/index.html";
				break;
			case "gettingstarted":
				url = "/HBNet/App/Content/HelpTopics/GettingStarted/index.html";
				break;
			case "transfers":
				url = "/HBNet/App/Content/HelpTopics/Transfers/index.html";
				break;
			case "cem":
				url = "/HBNet/App/Content/HelpTopics/CEM/index.html";
				break;
			case "text":
				url = "/HBNet/App/Content/HelpTopics/Text/index.html";
				break;
			case "history":
				url = "/HBNet/App/Content/HelpTopics/History/index.html";
				break;
		}

		var options = {
			'formType': 'GET',
			'title' : 'Help',
			'url' : url,
			'height':'750',
			'width':'784',
			'mainWindowId': 'MainDialogContent',
			'mainWindowConentId':'div_shrd_dw_iframeContainerContent',
			"iframeContainerId": 'div_shrd_dw_iframeContainer',
			"iframeHeight": "550px",
			'isIframe':true              
		};

		openMainDialogWindow(options);  
    }	
</script>
